items.reason: Initial load shows 'Loading your workspace…' and the create step flips to 'Creating…' within ~5 ms, but the profile step's Continue (updateSettings) shows no loading indicator at all: 1 s and even 5.3 s into the slow pending call the body text is byte-identical to the idle form and the button still reads 'Continue', enabled.

On the profile step, four rapid clicks on Continue under slow latency fired four parallel updateSettings calls in __apiLog; the button was never disabled (disabled:false at 250 ms). The create step does deduplicate (3 clicks → 1 call), but the profile primary action is unprotected.

items.reason: Clicking Continue (pending updateSettings, slow) and then Back returns the user to the welcome screen, but when the background call resolves seconds later the UI yanks them forward to the 'Create your first project' step with no user input — the abandoned action clobbers the user's chosen view.

Instrumented timing shows the success toast and dashboard render 27 ms after the API promise resolves (6048 ms vs 6021 ms after click), and on failure no success state ever appears; the page waits for server confirmation. (The confirmed dashboard does contradict the 'Project "Launch Plan" created!' toast by showing 'No projects yet', but the success state is not premature.)
